page_title: RealtyNinja - Awesome Websites for Busy Real Estate Agents - AI Listing Description Generator

summary.name: RealtyNinja AI Listing Description Generator
summary.one_liner: A free web tool that turns a spoken or typed description of a property into a polished real estate listing description using ChatGPT and OpenAI's Whisper speech-to-text.
use_cases: Writing a property listing description for an MLS or website
Dictating listing details by voice instead of typing
Producing listing copy from a few key facts about a home
Quickly drafting marketing text for condos and houses
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes a plain-language description of a listing, entered either by voice or by typing, and generates a listing description. Speech is converted to text with OpenAI's Whisper API, and that text is passed to ChatGPT along with the site's own data and parameters to produce the output. The page says it was built from many example real estate listings and follows set quality standards. The example on the page shows a 2-bedroom condo input turned into a fluent, marketing-style paragraph. It is presented as a standalone tool that users can bookmark after entering an email address.
notable: Voice or typed input, with speech converted by OpenAI Whisper
Uses ChatGPT with the vendor's own examples and parameters for output
Standalone tool, bookmarkable, requires only an email address to access
caveats: Requires entering an email address to access the tool
Output quality depends on the details supplied; the page gives no independent evaluation
Relies on third-party OpenAI services (Whisper and ChatGPT)
